title: Preserved source representation is not automatically raw-source materialization
failure_signature: A content-verified readable representation creates a document version and is silently relabeled materialized; a new logical document defaults to materialized without an explicitly verified raw version; a raw source adapter omits provenance and the database guesses; a research runner requires Release/source-pack/raw-PDF download before already preserved claim-relevant content may enter Grounded Evidence; or locator existence alone is treated as claim proof.
root_cause: Earlier code conflated three questions: whether an upstream document/locator is real, whether claim-relevant content was actually read and preserved, and whether byte-identical upstream raw bytes were downloaded. The coupling leaked into a broad document-version trigger, a materialized database default and a source-pack-first orchestration contract, turning transport mechanics into epistemic state and research blockers.
invariant: Source completeness is explicit and semantically distinct: new logical documents begin locator_verified; content_verified requires actually read claim-relevant content plus a faithful preserved representation and may create document versions/Evidence without raw bytes; materialized requires an explicit raw=true source fetch and a bound raw_materialized_document_version_id. A document_version alone never proves raw materialization, and missing raw/representation provenance fails closed. Research orchestration v2 verifies transport-neutral prepared material and must not require GitHub Release/source-pack/PDF download; legacy v1 remains replay compatibility only.
anti_regression: Do not default evidence.documents.source_capture_state to materialized.
Do not add a generic document_versions trigger that marks every logical source document materialized.
Do not allow a materialized document state without raw_materialized_document_version_id.
Do not infer raw=true from missing adapter provenance for new archived versions; supported source adapters must emit explicit raw=true or raw=false.
Do not treat expected_sha256 of a readable representation as a raw-PDF hash unless raw bytes were actually verified.
Do not let locator_verified support claim-level Evidence when claim-relevant content was never read.
Do not make --source-pack or GitHub Release mandatory for research-orchestration/v2 or future default execution contracts.
Do not delete or rewrite legacy Release/source-pack receipts merely because the default transport policy changed; mark them legacy/superseded and preserve replayability.

guards.description: New logical documents no longer manufacture raw materialized state by default.
Materialized state is structurally tied to an explicit raw document version.
Manual deferred materialization is an explicit verified transition tied to a document version.
Default orchestration verifies prepared local material rather than requiring a Release source pack.
Readable representations carry truthful non-raw provenance into persistence.
Regression test locks the locator default, explicit raw marker, state/version consistency and version-scoped materialization contract.

revisit_when: Revisit only if Longcycle adopts a richer source-material graph that still separately preserves logical source identity, actually read claim content, representation bytes and explicit raw-source materialization without transport-specific Evidence prerequisites.
